titulo: Por (not para) for through / along a place
regla: Use por + place for movement through, along, across or by way of a place: caminar por la playa, entrar por la ventana, pasar por Rosarito. Para + place gives the destination instead.

bloques.texto: **Por** + place describes the **route**: the space you move **through**, **along**, **around** or **past**.
Typical verbs: **caminar, pasear, correr, manejar, pasar, entrar, salir, viajar**.
**Entrar por** / **salir por** = _to go in / out through_ (a door, a window). **Mirar por la ventana** = _to look out the window_.
**Pasar por** + place = _to go past / by way of_: **pasamos por Rosarito**.
**Para** + place gives the **end point**: **voy para la playa** = _I'm heading to the beach_; **camino por la playa** = _I walk along the beach_.
Tip: **por** is the road under your feet; **para** is the sign at the end of it.

lista.en: Every morning I run along the boardwalk.

lista.es: ==Caminamos por== la playa hasta el muelle.
lista.en: We walked along the beach to the pier.
The cat came in through the window.

lista.es: Para ir a Ensenada, ==pasamos por== Rosarito.
lista.en: To get to Ensenada, we go through Rosarito.

lista.es: Me gusta ==pasear por== el centro los domingos.
lista.en: I like strolling around downtown on Sundays.

lista.es: El agua ==entra por== el techo cuando llueve.
lista.en: Water comes in through the roof when it rains.

lista.es: Ella ==miraba por== la ventana del camión.
lista.en: She was looking out the bus window.

filas.t: El ladrón entró para la ventana.
El ladrón entró por la ventana.

lista.texto: Around somewhere, not moving: [[5964|por for approximate location]].
Por with parts of the day: [[9344|en / a / por + part of the day]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _We walked through the park._
In Spanish: _He left through the back door._
lista.r: Salió por la puerta de atrás.

lista.p: Fix it: _Corro para la playa todas las mañanas_ (meaning along it).
